consequence.statement: Helm values under bgp.* (bgp.enabled, bgp.announce.podCIDR, bgp.announce.loadbalancerIP) no longer take effect; BGP announcements configured through these keys will not function unless migrated to bgpControlPlane options.
consequence.remediation: Remove bgp.* keys from Helm values and reconfigure BGP announcements using bgpControlPlane options as documented in the Cilium BGP control plane feature.

original.statement: Three Helm configuration keys for the metallb-bgp integration (bgp.enabled, bgp.announce.podCIDR, and bgp.announce.loadbalancerIP) have been removed; users must migrate to bgpControlPlane options for BGP announcements.

decision.reason: [ev-42d13e5eb7d7] states the metallb-bgp Helm options bgp.enabled, bgp.announce.podCIDR and bgp.announce.loadbalancerIP have been removed and users are now required to use bgpControlPlane options for BGP announcements. The values validators confirmed bgp is present in the source values and absent from the target values [ev-28e0ccb5774a, ev-39a22d88e2f5], so values set under bgp.* are no longer honoured; that is setting-ignored, with migration to bgpControlPlane as the remediation. The evidence does not directly state the high severity or that announcements stop, so confidence is low.
